description.content:
Upload and store a WebRTC dump file or a rtcstats file to your account using a chunked flow.

The API works in two steps:
  • - First upload chunks via multipart/form-data
  • - Then assemble via application/json
The API consumes one credit if successful.

Upload a webrtc-internal file or a rtcstats file, process it and return summary, observations and scores. By default the session is not stored: pass query save=true (or save=1) to also persist the dump like /upload.

Send the dump the same way as /upload: upload the file in chunks, then send a small JSON assemble request.

This API consumes one credit if successful.

For a rtcstats-server or any server that only needs the observations and scores projection. Processes a webrtc-internal file or a rtcstats file and returns just that projection: experience, audio, video, connectivity and observations scores, per-severity observation counts, flat trimmed observation records, and the user-agent data. The session is never stored.

Send the dump the same way as /upload: upload the file in chunks, then send a small JSON assemble request.

This API consumes one credit if successful.

Returns existing stored sessions for the token account ordered by creation date (newest first). All filters are optional. Different filters are AND-combined; multiple values within one filter are OR-combined.

query.description: Filter sessions whose title contains ANY of these substrings
Filter sessions whose title contains ANY of these substrings

Filter sessions that contain ANY of these observation type strings (exact type name, e.g. `turnNoConfig`). Comma-separated. Only critical/high/medium observations are indexed (low/info are excluded). The full catalog of types is available from GET /v1.0/observations. Up to 20 values.

Filter sessions that contain ANY of these observation type strings (exact type name, e.g. `turnNoConfig`). Comma-separated. Only critical/high/medium observations are indexed (low/info are excluded). The full catalog of types is available from GET /v1.0/observations. Up to 20 values.

Filter sessions whose observations carry ANY of these tags. Comma-separated. Valid tags: `connectivity`, `security`, `audio`, `video`, `datachannel`, `outbound`, `inbound`, `peripheral`, `behavior`, `network`, `configuration`, `cpu`, `bug`.

Filter sessions whose observations carry ANY of these tags. Comma-separated. Valid tags: `connectivity`, `security`, `audio`, `video`, `datachannel`, `outbound`, `inbound`, `peripheral`, `behavior`, `network`, `configuration`, `cpu`, `bug`.
Filter sessions by operating system (exact match). Examples: `macOS`, `Windows`, `Linux`, `Android`, `iPhone`, `iPad`.
Filter sessions by browser (exact match). Examples: `Chrome`, `Safari`, `Firefox`, `Edge`.
Filter sessions by major browser version (exact match, e.g. `142`).
Filter sessions by the end-user identifier carried in the rtcstats JWT (summary metadata user).
Filter sessions by the conference identifier carried in the rtcstats JWT (summary metadata conference).
Filter sessions by the session identifier carried in the rtcstats JWT (summary metadata session).
When `true`, only sessions with at least one critical-severity observation.
When `true`, only sessions with at least one high-severity observation.
When `true`, only sessions with at least one medium-severity observation.
When `true`, only sessions whose experience score is low (`< 60`).
When `true`, only sessions whose experience score is medium (`60` to `79`).
When `true`, only sessions whose experience score is high (`>= 80`).

API for third-party applications to upload, analyze, or use the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint at /v1.0/mcp.

Uses Bearer token authentication.

Number formatting: numeric values in responses are rounded, epoch timestamps to a whole millisecond and every other number to at most 2 decimals; integer counts and large identifiers are preserved.

Note: Need to create an application token in Settings from your paid account.
